_readme: S703 (worker levers for SkyDovekie), census lever 9 (Mt. San Antonio College, page not found, 28). Capture 44744647809 read these programs as not_found or page_claimed. Free page read 45029764686 printed each near-miss page, each claimed program's first candidate and an index page. Each program is filed here as a named gap with one reason. The state's lists were not read in this session (the coci_program_courses read goes to the conductor). No model call, no Supabase write.

reasons.no_own_page: No page in the catalog is the program's own.
reasons.own_page_coverage_low: The program's own page (its title); it prints few of the state's listed courses.
reasons.own_page_not_reached: The program's own page exists, and the capture's page list never reached it (a reader change: the page list, never a pin).
reasons.page_held_by_another_program: The page the capture reached holds another program the state lists, which the capture placed there; this one is an older or sibling listing.
